name: Cone dystrophy with supernormal rod response
aliases: Cone dystrophy with supernormal rod ERG response

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Electroretinographic diagnostic criteria for cone dystrophy with supernormal rod response

criteria.description: Presence of supernormal rod response on electroretinogram (ERG) with abnormally reduced cone responses
Progressive loss of central vision with photophobia and color vision defects
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with CDSR (e.g., KCNV2 mutations)
Fundus changes including macular atrophy or bull's eye maculopathy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic ERG findings combined with clinical symptoms of cone dysfunction; genetic confirmation supports diagnosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: ERG testing is critical for diagnosis; genetic testing may confirm but is not mandatory.

searchTerms: unusually strong rod cell response in eye test
worsening vision in center of eye
bull's eye pattern in eye exam
central retinal lesion with ring pattern

common.symptomName: Difficulty with daylight vision (photopic vision impairment)
searchTerms: difficulty with vision in well-lit conditions

occasional.notes: Peripheral vision often remains intact in early stages

rare.symptomName: Electronegative ERG waveform in scotopic conditions
searchTerms: abnormal negative wave in dark-adapted eye test
reduced retinal response in low light

imaging: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing macular atrophy or photoreceptor layer disruption
Fundus autofluorescence revealing bull's eye maculopathy
other: Electroretinogram (ERG) demonstrating supernormal rod responses and reduced cone responses

distinguishingFeatures: Complete absence of cone function without supernormal rod response
Congenital onset with nystagmus and photophobia
Both cone and rod functions progressively impaired without supernormal rod ERG

redFlags: Rapid progression of central vision loss
Onset of nyctalopia indicating rod involvement
references: Khan NW, et al. Cone dystrophy with supernormal rod ERG: clinical and genetic characterization. Ophthalmology. 2018.
Orphanet: Cone dystrophy with supernormal rod response. ORPHA:209932.
